answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as the zenith of Sybil resistance in AI economies by anchoring identity to verifiable capital rather than compute power. An attacker attempting to flood the network must accumulate significant tokens, a task as arduous as traversing a frozen tundra. This cost ensures that identity creation is gated by economic sacrifice, preventing malicious actors from spawning infinite nodes, much like the rigid, unyielding roots of a cedar tree securing its position against the volatile landscape of decentralized consensus.
